fields.label: Description
fields.description: Phase 22A.5 — shown in the manage-list meta line; optional, free text (genuinely open domain, not a guess-field).

fields.label: Project
fields.description: Required when Scope = Project. Blank for workspace-scope rules.

fields.label: Scope
fields.description: Workspace-scope rules run across every project (or a filtered subset) and may only be created/edited by a workspace admin.

fields.label: Project Filter
fields.description: Workspace-scope only. List of project names this rule applies to; empty = every project.

fields.label: Trigger DocType
fields.description: Optional. Reserved for future non-task triggers; leave blank for task rules.

fields.label: Trigger Event
fields.options:
task.created
task.updated
task.status_changed
task.assigned
task.unassigned
task.due_soon
task.overdue
task.field_changed
task.moved_sprint
task.deleted
comment.added
schedule.recurring
schedule.relative
erp.invoice_submitted
erp.payment_received
erp.so_confirmed
erp.doc_event
external.webhook

fields.label: Trigger Config
fields.description: task.field_changed: {field, from?, to?}. schedule.relative: {field, offset_days, direction: before|after}.

fields.label: Interval (seconds)
fields.description: For recurring rules: how often to fire. Runs on the automation agent.

fields.label: First Run
fields.description: Optional. When the first fire should happen; defaults to one interval from now.

fields.label: Bridge Job ID
fields.description: Internal: the agent's job id for this scheduled rule.

fields.label: Conditions
fields.description: For erp.doc_event, scope to a specific doctype+lifecycle-event with e.g. [{"field": "doctype", "op": "eq", "value": "Purchase Order"}, {"field": "erp_event", "op": "eq", "value": "on_submit"}] — a rule with no such clause matches EVERY doctype's EVERY lifecycle event. For external.webhook, scope to a specific third-party event name with [{"field": "event", "op": "eq", "value": "payment.succeeded"}]; unmatched top-level keys from the webhook body are also resolvable as condition fields directly.

fields.label: Actions
fields.description: Ordered list [{type, config}, ...], run in sequence with per-action isolation. Supersedes Action Type/Action Config below (kept for one release for rollback).

fields.label: Action Type (legacy)
fields.options:
Change Status
Assign Issue
Set Priority
Set Due Date
Add Label
Add Comment
Notify
Create Issue
Update ERPNext Document
fields.description: Superseded by Actions (v2, multi-action). Kept hidden/read-only for one release for rollback safety.
